identity.note: Full published PMC article, not merely an abstract or repository title. Held source hash independently recomputed; stale availability failure is not inherited as a reading result.

component_inventory.note: Inventory of published article components is complete; reading is not. extent_evidence.locator: All948 lines of full article-only extraction.

coverage.locator: Complete lines1-948, all article sections and captions.

components.note: Complete held HTML text read; figure pixels and original table structure checked separately. A full main-text read does not close supplement access.

All four pedigrees, variant keys and clinical photographs read. SPA1 two affected homozygous siblings, carrier parents; JPN1 maternalQ29L/paternalframeshift and two unaffected frameshift carriers; ITA1 maternalG297V/paternalR430K. USA1 is not an assigned packet.

All six MRI panels and four biopsy rows read: SPA1/P1 cervical and thigh changes; ITA1/P4 thigh and leg changes. JPN1/P3 age5 versus20 rimmed-vacuole progression. H&E, GT and oxidative stains/scale labels inspected; no new image diagnosis inferred.

All exon/protein diagrams, eight sequence alignment rows, RNA-seq panel and structural models read. P3 expression53% with41/41Q29L and1/44frameshift reads; no patient genomic VCF normalization can be validated from the screenshot. Models are predictions.

All A-F graphs and blot lanes/controls read. Adult/fetal/cell expression, differentiation time course, recombinant standard, P1 versus two controls, mouse EDL/soleus. P1 abundance appears comparable; not a quantified rescue assay.

All A-F panels read. Thermal-shift curves and three biological averages: S447P/M70T/C268S lower melting temperature; Q29L does not share that reported change. CD spectra at15/25/55/95C overlap; no exact digitization performed.

All A-G panels read: images, movement assay, mixed-progeny survival curves, four variant partial-rescue curves, ultrastructure, density and membrane-detachment plots. Survival panels include mixed-genotype progeny; do not reinterpret percent survival as exclusively mutant denominator. Raw data not reanalysed.

All A-F panels read: dose survival to6dpf, two dose image pairs, minimal swimming scatter, ultrastructure, density and membrane detachment with95%CI. Animal rescue is partial and not a human treatment result; treatment does not restore normal development.

evidence.locator: Genetic investigations, lines538-544; original Figure1A checked.

causal_confidence.statement: Source presents biallelic HMGCS1 variants as a new rigid-spine myopathy association, supported by segregation and functional experiments on four missense variants. Packet SOLVED/CAUSATIVE is compatible with the proposed association, but its formal ACMG PATHOGENIC assignment cannot be verified from the available article; missing Supplementary Table1 prevents closing that assertion.

evidence.locator: Abstract, Genetic investigations, functional results, Discussion and Supplementary material.

limitations: No formal ACMG criterion-level classification identified in reviewed main text; missing supplement is not evidence of a lower classification. No independent clinical reclassification performed.
S447P and Q29L have partial rescue evidence in zebrafish; Q29L retains/increases the initial enzymatic rate. Reduced animal rescue is not proof of a single loss-of-activity mechanism.
OMIM621433 disease naming is packet annotation, not an independently verified current database assertion.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All assigned phenotype items, explicit negatives, sex, age, disease onset and death status have been checked.
